WITH album_rates AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
    AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
with_overall AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    average_unit_price,
    average_bytes_per_millisecond,
    AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) OVER () AS all_album_average
  FROM album_rates
)
SELECT
  AlbumId,
  average_unit_price,
  average_bytes_per_millisecond,
  average_bytes_per_millisecond - all_album_average AS difference_from_all_album_average
FROM with_overall
ORDER BY difference_from_all_album_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
